scope: Final targeted synchronization and committed-restore failure review

synchronization.reproduced: A resource query begun before a native commit resolved during the 80ms coalescing window; completion time suppressed invalidation and unchanged checkpoint recovery left stale data fresh.
synchronization.correction: Cancel matching reads before invalidation, without completion-time freshness assumptions; throwOnError keeps failed active refetches queued for retry.

restore.reproduced: In an isolated temporary profile, a directory at preferences.json rejects atomic replacement with Windows error5. Learning generation and content had already changed, but the old API returned Err and suppressed the restore event.
restore.correction: Successful DB replacement returns RestoreResult with explicit post-commit warnings; playback reconciliation continues and exactly one Restore notification publishes after native locks are released.
